name: Pola-R-CHP (Polatuzumab vedotin + Rituximab + Cyclophosphamide + Doxorubicin + Prednisone)

biomarkers.CD20: positive (required for the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab)
biomarkers.CD79b: target of polatuzumab vedotin (expressed on B cells; not a separate testing gate)
biomarkers.note: Rituximab requires CD20 positivity; CD20-negative disease should be re-biopsied to confirm antigen expression before anti-CD20 therapy (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, lines 253 to 254, 566). Polatuzumab vedotin is a CD79b-directed antibody-drug conjugate; CD79b is broadly expressed on B cells and is not a separate eligibility gate. Pola-R-CHP is a category 1 option for IPI >=2 (line 4158).

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) therapy; Pola-R-CHP is a category 1 option for IPI >=2

drugs.name: Polatuzumab vedotin

provenance.locator: VERIFY: polatuzumab vedotin dose not printed in the provided extracts. drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. POLARIX Pola-R-CHP uses polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle, but that dose is not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts. CD79b-directed ADC (MMAE payload); monitor for peripheral neuropathy. Verify dose before activation.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for Pola-R-CHP (POLARIX) in previously untreated DLBCL (#75). Rituximab 375 mg/m2 (day 1) is dose-grounded (Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457). The CHP backbone is grounded to the StewardMD R1-approved R-CHOP (kb/protocols/rchop.json): cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 day 1 (anthracycline cap warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2), and the steroid 100 mg flat days 1 to 5 (rchop names it Prednisolone; this file uses Prednisone, the same interchangeable CHOP steroid at 100 mg flat days 1 to 5). Only polatuzumab vedotin remains VERIFY (conventionally 1.8 mg/kg day 1), not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts. Regimen identity and the category-1 status for IPI >=2 are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026 (line 4158); the R-CHP + polatuzumab benefit over R-CHOP is noted in DeVita (lines 268332 to 268334). Pola-R-CHP replaces vincristine (of R-CHOP) with polatuzumab. ISMP tall-man applied (DOXOrubicin); anthracycline cumulative cap 450/550 mg/m2; rituximab premedication and HBV screening required. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
